instruction: Reverse proxy all traffic for app.example.com on port 80 to a Node.js service on 127.0.0.1:3000, passing the standard forwarding headers.
Proxy requests for reports.example.com to 127.0.0.1:8000 with a 5s connect timeout, a 120s read timeout and a 60s send timeout.
Proxy to the Gunicorn Unix socket at /run/gunicorn/gunicorn.sock instead of a TCP port for django.example.com.
Forward /api/ requests to the backend on 127.0.0.1:9000 and strip the /api prefix before the request reaches it.
Keep the full /api/... path intact while proxying /api/ traffic to 127.0.0.1:9000 with no prefix stripping.
Proxy the live event stream at /events to 127.0.0.1:7000 with response buffering disabled and a long read timeout.
Proxy to an HTTPS backend at api.internal.example:8443 with TLS SNI enabled and certificate verification against the internal CA.
Proxy the slow report generator at /reports with a 10s connect timeout and a 10 minute read and send timeout.
Hide the X-Powered-By and Server headers sent by the PHP backend that sits behind nginx for php.example.com.
Preserve the client port in the Host header when proxying to a backend on 127.0.0.1:8080 that logs it.
Allow up to 50 MB request bodies for the /upload API that is proxied to 127.0.0.1:9100.
Forward incoming Stripe webhooks to the handler on 127.0.0.1:9300 without buffering the request body.
Route / to the frontend on 127.0.0.1:5173 and /admin to the admin panel on 127.0.0.1:4000 in one server block.
Allocate larger proxy buffers for a backend that returns big response headers such as JWT session cookies.
Proxy to a Kubernetes service resolved at request time using the cluster DNS resolver with a 30s cache and a dynamic proxy_pass variable.
Show a friendly maintenance page when the upstream returns 502, 503 or 504 instead of the raw nginx error.
Terminate gRPC traffic on port 443 and pass it to the Go service listening on 127.0.0.1:50051.
Enable TCP keepalive on the connections nginx uses to reach the backend on 127.0.0.1:8090.
Pass the authenticated client TLS certificate details to the identity-aware proxy at 127.0.0.1:8443.
Stop nginx from retrying a different backend after a failed POST to /checkout so payment requests are never duplicated.
